name: Open a product and add the asymmetric hoodie in its default color
description: Verifies the hoodie opens with lemon selected by default and can be added to the cart with the selected size.
steps: Confirm color ACID LEMON is selected
expected: ASYMMETRIC HOODIE is visible in the cart and the cart item shows color ACID LEMON and size L.

name: Show the cleaned individual product photos
description: Verifies the first tee gallery has 6 photos, the second tee gallery has 7 photos, and the hoodie gallery has 7 photos, with the requested fifth photos removed.
steps: Advance through the gallery with the right arrow
Open the WRONG TEE card and advance through its gallery
Open the ASYMMETRIC HOODIE card and advance through its gallery
expected: The first tee shows 6 photos, the second tee shows 7 photos, and the hoodie shows 7 photos; the second tee switches to the supplied white and blue photo sets with each collage frame cropped cleanly and the full T-shirt visible.

name: Remove the last cart item with the minus button
description: Verifies that pressing minus on an item with quantity one removes that item from the cart completely.
steps: Select a size and add one item to the cart
Press the minus button for that item
expected: The item is removed from the cart and the cart count decreases accordingly.

name: Use the default black color on a tee with size and quantity
description: Verifies the tee color gallery behavior, including switching the first and second tees to their supplied white and blue photo sets.
steps: Confirm the product gallery switches to the supplied white photo set
Confirm the product gallery switches to the supplied blue photo set
Add the product to the cart
expected: The cart shows ASYMMETRIC TEE in ЧЁРНЫЙ, size M, with quantity 2.

name: Open an existing tee without showing its description on the card
description: Verifies catalog cards stay minimal while product details remain available after opening the card.
expected: The catalog card shows the uploaded product photo with only the product name and price; clicking it opens the product view.

name: Require a size before adding to cart while retaining the default color
description: Verifies the default color is already selected but the product still requires a size before it can be added.
steps: Open the catalog on a mobile viewport
Click В КОРЗИНУ without selecting a size
expected: A visible message asks the user to choose a size and no item is added to the cart.
